england.name: Anglo-Saxon England
england.summary: Anglo-Saxon kingdoms such as Wessex and Mercia converted to Christianity and fought the Vikings, until Wessex united England in 927.
england.summary_zh: 威塞克斯、麦西亚等盎格鲁-撒克逊王国并立，皈依基督教并抵御维京人，927年由威塞克斯统一英格兰。

england.name: Norman England
england.summary: William the Conqueror won at Hastings and imposed Norman lords, castles, feudalism and the Domesday survey.
england.summary_zh: 征服者威廉赢得黑斯廷斯之战，引入诺曼贵族、城堡与封建制度，并编制《末日审判书》。

england.name: Plantagenet England
england.summary: Angevin kings ruled lands in England and France; Magna Carta and Parliament emerged, and the Hundred Years' War began.
england.summary_zh: 安茹系国王统治英法两地领土；《大宪章》和议会在此时诞生，英法百年战争爆发。

england.name: Lancaster and York
england.summary: Rival branches of the Plantagenets lost the Hundred Years' War and fought each other in the Wars of the Roses.
england.summary_zh: 金雀花王族的两个分支相继统治，输掉百年战争，并在玫瑰战争中互相厮杀。

england.name: Tudor England
england.summary: Henry VIII broke with Rome to found the Church of England, and Elizabeth I presided over a Protestant golden age and the defeat of the Armada.
england.summary_zh: 亨利八世与罗马决裂、创立英国国教会，伊丽莎白一世时代新教文化繁荣并击败西班牙无敌舰队。

england.name: Early Stuart Britain
england.summary: James I united the English and Scottish crowns; clashes between Charles I and Parliament led to civil war.
england.summary_zh: 詹姆斯一世使英格兰与苏格兰共戴一君；查理一世与议会的冲突最终引发英国内战。

england.name: Commonwealth and Protectorate
england.summary: After Charles I was executed England became a republic, ruled from 1653 by Oliver Cromwell as Lord Protector.
england.summary_zh: 查理一世被处决后英格兰成为共和国，1653年起由护国公奥利弗·克伦威尔统治。

england.name: Restoration and Later Stuarts
england.name_zh: 复辟与斯图亚特王朝后期
england.summary: The monarchy was restored, the Glorious Revolution of 1688 established parliamentary supremacy, and the 1707 Union created Great Britain.
england.summary_zh: 君主制复辟，1688年光荣革命确立议会至上，1707年《联合法案》组成大不列颠王国。

england.name: Hanoverian Georgian Era
england.summary: Under the Hanoverian Georges, Britain built a global empire, lost America and began the Industrial Revolution.
england.summary_zh: 汉诺威王朝的几位乔治在位期间，英国建立全球帝国、失去北美殖民地并开启工业革命。

england.name: Victorian Era
england.summary: Britain was the workshop of the world and ruled the largest empire in history, while reforms slowly widened the vote.
england.summary_zh: 英国成为“世界工厂”，统治史上最大的帝国，同时选举权在改革中逐步扩大。

england.name: Edwardian Era and World Wars
england.name_zh: 爱德华时代与两次世界大战
england.summary: From Edwardian confidence Britain passed through two world wars, mass democracy and the Depression.
england.summary_zh: 英国由爱德华时代的自信走入两次世界大战，经历了大众民主的到来与大萧条。

england.name: Postwar Britain
england.summary: Britain built the welfare state, gave up its empire, joined and later left the European Union.
england.summary_zh: 英国建立福利国家，帝国解体，先加入欧洲共同体，后又脱离欧盟。

france.name: Merovingian Franks
france.summary: Clovis united the Franks, converted to Catholicism and conquered Gaul, founding a dynasty that later weakened under palace mayors.
france.summary_zh: 克洛维统一法兰克人、皈依天主教并征服高卢，建立的王朝后期大权旁落于宫相之手。

france.name: Carolingian Franks
france.summary: Pepin and Charlemagne built a Christian empire across Western Europe, which was divided among his heirs in 843.
france.summary_zh: 丕平与查理曼建立横跨西欧的基督教帝国，843年由其继承人瓜分。

france.name: Capetian France
france.summary: Starting from a small royal domain around Paris, Capetian kings gradually extended royal power over the great feudal lords.
france.summary_zh: 卡佩诸王从巴黎周边的狭小王室领地起步，逐步将王权扩展到各大封建领主之上。

france.name: Valois France
france.summary: The Valois survived the Hundred Years' War with help from Joan of Arc, then entered the Renaissance and the Wars of Religion.
france.summary_zh: 瓦卢瓦王朝在圣女贞德帮助下熬过百年战争，随后迎来文艺复兴，又陷入宗教战争。

france.name: Bourbon Ancien Régime
france.summary: Henry IV ended the religious wars and Louis XIV made France the leading absolute monarchy of Europe.
france.summary_zh: 亨利四世结束宗教战争，路易十四使法国成为欧洲首屈一指的绝对君主制国家。

france.name: French Revolution
france.summary: The Revolution abolished the monarchy and feudal privilege, proclaimed the Rights of Man and ended in Napoleon's Consulate.
france.summary_zh: 大革命废除君主制与封建特权，颁布《人权宣言》，最终以拿破仑执政府告终。

france.name: First French Empire
france.summary: Napoleon crowned himself emperor, codified French law and conquered much of Europe before his defeat.
france.summary_zh: 拿破仑加冕称帝，颁布《民法典》，征服欧洲大部分地区，最终战败。

france.name: Restoration and July Monarchy
france.summary: The Bourbons returned under a constitutional charter, until the 1830 revolution brought Louis-Philippe's bourgeois monarchy.
france.summary_zh: 波旁王朝在宪章约束下复辟，1830年革命后路易-菲利普建立资产阶级的七月王朝。

france.name: Second Republic and Second Empire
france.name_zh: 第二共和国与第二帝国
france.summary: The 1848 revolution created a short-lived republic, which Louis-Napoleon turned into an empire of modernisation until defeat by Prussia.
france.summary_zh: 1848年革命建立短暂的共和国，路易-拿破仑随后将其改为帝国，推行现代化，直至败于普鲁士。

france.name: Third Republic
france.summary: A durable parliamentary republic secularised France, built a colonial empire and won the First World War.
france.summary_zh: 持久的议会共和国推动法国世俗化，建立殖民帝国，并赢得第一次世界大战。

france.name: Vichy and Fourth Republic
france.name_zh: 维希政权与第四共和国
france.summary: After the 1940 defeat and Vichy collaboration, the liberated Fourth Republic rebuilt France but fell over the Algerian war.
france.summary_zh: 1940年战败与维希政权合作之后，解放后的第四共和国重建法国，却因阿尔及利亚战争而垮台。

france.name: Fifth Republic
france.summary: De Gaulle's constitution created a strong presidency; France decolonised and became a pillar of European integration.
france.summary_zh: 戴高乐主导的宪法确立了强势总统制；法国完成去殖民化，成为欧洲一体化的支柱。

holy-roman-empire.name: East Francia
holy-roman-empire.summary: The Treaty of Verdun gave Louis the German the eastern Frankish lands, ruled by late Carolingians and Conrad I.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 《凡尔登条约》将法兰克东部土地分给日耳曼人路易，由晚期加洛林诸王及康拉德一世统治。

holy-roman-empire.name: Ottonian Dynasty
holy-roman-empire.summary: Saxon kings defeated the Magyars at Lechfeld, and Otto I was crowned emperor in Rome in 962, founding the Holy Roman Empire.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 萨克森诸王在莱希费尔德击败马扎尔人，奥托一世于962年在罗马加冕，开创神圣罗马帝国。

holy-roman-empire.name: Salian Dynasty
holy-roman-empire.summary: Salian emperors clashed with the papacy in the Investiture Controversy, symbolised by Henry IV at Canossa.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 萨利安王朝诸帝与教廷爆发叙任权之争，亨利四世的“卡诺莎之行”是其象征。

holy-roman-empire.name: Hohenstaufen Dynasty
holy-roman-empire.summary: Frederick Barbarossa and Frederick II sought to rule Italy as well as Germany, fighting the papacy and Lombard cities.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 腓特烈一世“红胡子”与腓特烈二世力图兼治德意两地，与教廷及伦巴第城市长期争战。

holy-roman-empire.name: Interregnum and Rival Houses
holy-roman-empire.name_zh: 大空位时期与诸家争立
holy-roman-empire.summary: After the Great Interregnum the princes elected kings from rival houses such as Habsburg and Wittelsbach, weakening central power.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 大空位时期后，诸侯从哈布斯堡、维特尔斯巴赫等家族中选立国王，中央权力日渐衰弱。

holy-roman-empire.name: Luxembourg Emperors
holy-roman-empire.summary: Charles IV's Golden Bull of 1356 fixed the seven prince-electors, and Prague became an imperial capital.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 查理四世于1356年颁布《金玺诏书》确定七大选帝侯，布拉格成为帝国都城。

holy-roman-empire.name: Habsburg Ascendancy
holy-roman-empire.summary: The Habsburgs held the imperial crown almost continuously, and Maximilian I attempted imperial reform through dynastic marriages.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 哈布斯堡家族几乎不间断地占据皇位，马克西米利安一世通过联姻扩张并尝试帝国改革。

holy-roman-empire.name: Reformation and Thirty Years' War
holy-roman-empire.name_zh: 宗教改革与三十年战争
holy-roman-empire.summary: Luther's Reformation split the Empire into Catholic and Protestant states, culminating in the devastating Thirty Years' War.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 路德的宗教改革使帝国分裂为天主教和新教诸邦，最终酿成惨烈的三十年战争。

holy-roman-empire.name: Post-Westphalian Empire
holy-roman-empire.name_zh: 威斯特伐利亚和约后的帝国
holy-roman-empire.summary: The Peace of Westphalia left the Empire a loose federation of sovereign princes until Napoleon dissolved it in 1806.
holy-roman-empire.summary_zh: 《威斯特伐利亚和约》使帝国成为主权诸侯的松散联合体，直至1806年被拿破仑解散。

germany.name: Margraviate of Brandenburg
germany.summary: Albert the Bear founded the march of Brandenburg, and German settlers colonised the lands east of the Elbe.
germany.summary_zh: “大熊”阿尔布雷希特建立勃兰登堡边区，德意志移民向易北河以东拓殖。

germany.name: Hohenzollern Brandenburg
germany.name_zh: 霍亨索伦家族的勃兰登堡
germany.summary: The Hohenzollerns became electors of Brandenburg, adopted Lutheranism and acquired claims to Prussia.
germany.summary_zh: 霍亨索伦家族成为勃兰登堡选帝侯，改信路德宗，并获得对普鲁士的继承权。

germany.name: Brandenburg-Prussia
germany.summary: United with the Duchy of Prussia, the state recovered from the Thirty Years' War under the Great Elector, who built a standing army.
germany.summary_zh: 与普鲁士公国合并后，国家在“大选侯”治下从三十年战争中恢复，并建立常备军。

germany.name: Kingdom of Prussia
germany.summary: Prussia became a kingdom and, under Frederick the Great, a militarised great power that seized Silesia.
germany.summary_zh: 普鲁士升格为王国，在腓特烈大帝治下成为军事化强国并夺取西里西亚。

germany.name: Prussian Reform and Restoration
germany.summary: Defeated by Napoleon, Prussia reformed its army and society, gained the Rhineland and led the Zollverein customs union.
germany.summary_zh: 败于拿破仑后，普鲁士改革军队与社会，获得莱茵兰，并主导德意志关税同盟。

germany.name: Bismarck's Unification
germany.summary: Bismarck's "blood and iron" wars against Denmark, Austria and France united Germany under Prussia.
germany.summary_zh: 俾斯麦以“铁血政策”先后战胜丹麦、奥地利和法国，在普鲁士主导下统一德国。

germany.name: German Empire
germany.summary: The Kaiserreich became an industrial and military giant, then was defeated in the First World War.
germany.summary_zh: 德意志帝国成为工业与军事巨人，随后在第一次世界大战中战败。

germany.name: Weimar Republic
germany.summary: Germany's first democracy struggled with reparations, hyperinflation and the Depression.
germany.summary_zh: 德国第一个民主政体在赔款、恶性通胀与大萧条中艰难挣扎。

germany.name: Nazi Germany
germany.summary: Hitler's dictatorship launched the Second World War and the Holocaust, ending in total defeat in 1945.
germany.summary_zh: 希特勒的独裁政权发动第二次世界大战并实施大屠杀，1945年彻底战败。

germany.name: Divided Germany
germany.summary: Occupied Germany split into the democratic West and communist East, divided by the Berlin Wall during the Cold War.
germany.summary_zh: 被占领的德国分裂为民主的西德与共产主义的东德，冷战中以柏林墙相隔。

germany.name: Reunified Germany
germany.summary: After the Wall fell Germany reunited in 1990 and became the leading power of the European Union.
germany.summary_zh: 柏林墙倒塌后，德国于1990年重新统一，成为欧盟的主导力量。

spain.name: Castile of the Reconquista
spain.name_zh: 收复失地运动中的卡斯蒂利亚
spain.summary: Castile emerged as a kingdom, took Toledo in 1085 and pushed south against al-Andalus, reaching Seville by 1248.
spain.summary_zh: 卡斯蒂利亚成为王国，1085年攻取托莱多，向安达卢斯不断南进，1248年夺取塞维利亚。

spain.name: Late Medieval Castile
spain.name_zh: 中世纪晚期的卡斯蒂利亚
spain.summary: Alfonso X fostered learning, while civil wars brought the Trastámara dynasty to power in a dominant Castile.
spain.summary_zh: 阿方索十世倡导学术，而内战使特拉斯塔马拉王朝在强大的卡斯蒂利亚掌权。

spain.name: Catholic Monarchs
spain.summary: Isabella and Ferdinand united Castile and Aragon, conquered Granada and sponsored Columbus in 1492.
spain.summary_zh: 伊莎贝拉与斐迪南联姻统一卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡，1492年攻克格拉纳达并资助哥伦布远航。

spain.name: Habsburg Spain
spain.summary: Charles V and Philip II ruled a global empire fed by American silver, the Golden Age of Spanish art and power.
spain.summary_zh: 查理五世与腓力二世统治着靠美洲白银支撑的全球帝国，是西班牙艺术与国力的黄金时代。

spain.name: Bourbon Spain
spain.summary: The War of Spanish Succession brought the Bourbons, who centralised the state and reformed the American empire.
spain.summary_zh: 西班牙王位继承战争后波旁王朝入主，推行中央集权，改革美洲殖民体制。

spain.name: Revolutions and Carlist Wars
spain.name_zh: 革命与卡洛斯战争时期
spain.summary: The Napoleonic invasion triggered the loss of most American colonies, liberal constitutions, Carlist civil wars and the short First Republic.
spain.summary_zh: 拿破仑入侵导致大部分美洲殖民地丧失，其后自由派立宪、卡洛斯战争迭起，并有短命的第一共和国。

spain.name: Bourbon Restoration
spain.summary: A restored constitutional monarchy rotated power between two parties, lost Cuba in 1898 and ended in Primo de Rivera's dictatorship.
spain.summary_zh: 复辟的君主立宪制由两党轮流执政，1898年失去古巴，最后演变为普里莫·德里维拉的独裁。

spain.name: Second Republic and Civil War
spain.name_zh: 第二共和国与西班牙内战
spain.summary: The reforming Second Republic polarised Spain and collapsed into the 1936–39 Civil War.
spain.summary_zh: 推行改革的第二共和国造成社会严重分化，最终陷入1936至1939年的内战。

spain.name: Franco Dictatorship
spain.summary: General Franco ruled an authoritarian Catholic state, isolated at first and then transformed by rapid growth in the 1960s.
spain.summary_zh: 佛朗哥将军统治着威权的天主教国家，起初遭受孤立，60年代起经济高速增长。

spain.name: Democratic Spain
spain.summary: The transition under Juan Carlos I produced the 1978 constitution, regional autonomy and EU membership.
spain.summary_zh: 胡安·卡洛斯一世主导民主转型，制定1978年宪法，实行地区自治并加入欧盟。

portugal.name: Burgundian Dynasty
portugal.summary: Afonso Henriques declared himself king, and his heirs completed the reconquest of the Algarve by 1249.
portugal.summary_zh: 阿方索·恩里克斯自立为王，其后继者于1249年收复阿尔加维，完成收复失地运动。

portugal.name: Aviz Dynasty and Discoveries
portugal.summary: After victory at Aljubarrota, Portuguese navigators rounded Africa, reached India and built a seaborne empire.
portugal.summary_zh: 阿尔茹巴罗塔之战胜利后，葡萄牙航海家绕过非洲抵达印度，建立海上帝国。

portugal.name: Iberian Union
portugal.summary: After the king died without heir, Portugal shared its monarch with Spain under the Habsburg Philips.
portugal.summary_zh: 国王无嗣而终后，葡萄牙与西班牙共戴哈布斯堡王朝的几位腓力为君。

portugal.name: Braganza Restoration
portugal.summary: A revolt restored independence under the Braganzas, whose wealth came from Brazilian gold; Lisbon was rebuilt after the 1755 earthquake.
portugal.summary_zh: 起义使葡萄牙在布拉干萨王朝下恢复独立，巴西黄金带来财富；1755年大地震后里斯本重建。

portugal.name: Exile and Constitutional Monarchy
portugal.summary: The court fled Napoleon to Brazil, which later became independent, while Portugal endured liberal wars and a fragile constitutional monarchy.
portugal.summary_zh: 王室为躲避拿破仑迁往巴西，巴西后来独立；葡萄牙本土经历自由派战争和脆弱的君主立宪制。

portugal.name: First Republic
portugal.summary: The monarchy was overthrown, but the unstable republic saw dozens of governments before a military coup.
portugal.summary_zh: 君主制被推翻，但共和国动荡不安，政府频繁更迭，最终被军事政变推翻。

portugal.name: Estado Novo
portugal.summary: Military rule gave way to Salazar's authoritarian Estado Novo, which fought long colonial wars in Africa.
portugal.summary_zh: 军政府之后是萨拉查的威权“新国家”政权，在非洲进行了长期的殖民战争。

portugal.name: Democratic Portugal
portugal.name_zh: 康乃馨革命后的民主葡萄牙
portugal.summary: The Carnation Revolution ended dictatorship and empire, and Portugal joined the European Community in 1986.
portugal.summary_zh: 康乃馨革命结束了独裁和殖民帝国，葡萄牙于1986年加入欧洲共同体。

italy.name: County of Savoy
italy.summary: Humbert the White-Handed founded the House of Savoy, which controlled Alpine passes between France and Italy.
italy.summary_zh: “白手”翁贝托建立萨伏依家族，控制着法国与意大利之间的阿尔卑斯山口。

italy.name: Duchy of Savoy
italy.summary: Raised to a duchy, Savoy moved its capital to Turin and survived between the French and Spanish great powers.
italy.summary_zh: 萨伏依升为公国，迁都都灵，在法国和西班牙两强之间求存。

italy.name: Kingdom of Sardinia
italy.summary: The dukes won a royal crown at Utrecht, exchanging Sicily for Sardinia in 1720, and built an absolutist state in Piedmont.
italy.summary_zh: 萨伏依公爵在乌得勒支和约中获得王冠，1720年以西西里换取撒丁，在皮埃蒙特建立专制国家。

italy.name: Napoleonic Italy
italy.summary: Napoleon's campaigns drove the kings to Sardinia, annexed Piedmont to France and spread revolutionary ideas across Italy.
italy.summary_zh: 拿破仑的远征将国王逐往撒丁岛，皮埃蒙特并入法国，革命思想传遍意大利。

italy.name: Restoration and Risorgimento
italy.summary: Restored Piedmont-Sardinia led the movement for unification under Cavour, with Garibaldi conquering the south.
italy.summary_zh: 复辟后的皮埃蒙特-撒丁在加富尔领导下推动统一，加里波第则征服了南方。

italy.name: Liberal Kingdom of Italy
italy.name_zh: 自由主义时期的意大利王国
italy.summary: The new Kingdom of Italy took Rome in 1870, industrialised in the north and fought on the Allied side in the First World War.
italy.summary_zh: 新生的意大利王国于1870年夺取罗马，北方工业化，并在一战中加入协约国一方。

italy.name: Fascist Italy
italy.summary: Mussolini's Fascist dictatorship pursued empire in Africa and allied with Hitler, collapsing in the Second World War.
italy.summary_zh: 墨索里尼的法西斯独裁在非洲谋求帝国，并与希特勒结盟，最终在二战中覆灭。

italy.name: First Italian Republic
italy.summary: A referendum created the Republic, which enjoyed an economic miracle under Christian Democrat governments.
italy.summary_zh: 全民公投建立共和国，在天主教民主党政府领导下创造了经济奇迹。

italy.name: Second Italian Republic
italy.summary: After corruption scandals destroyed the old parties, a new bipolar politics emerged within the eurozone.
italy.summary_zh: 腐败丑闻摧毁旧政党后，意大利在欧元区内形成新的两极政治格局。

russia.name: Principality of Moscow
russia.summary: A small principality under Mongol overlordship, Moscow grew by collecting tribute for the Golden Horde and defeating rivals.
russia.summary_zh: 莫斯科作为蒙古统治下的小公国，借替金帐汗国征收贡赋并击败对手而壮大。

russia.name: Gathering of the Russian Lands
russia.name_zh: 莫斯科大公国统一罗斯
russia.summary: Ivan III threw off the Mongol yoke and annexed Novgorod, making Moscow the centre of a unified Russian state.
russia.summary_zh: 伊凡三世摆脱蒙古枷锁并吞并诺夫哥罗德，使莫斯科成为统一的俄罗斯国家中心。

russia.name: Tsardom and Time of Troubles
russia.summary: Ivan the Terrible was crowned tsar and conquered Kazan; after his line died out, the Time of Troubles brought civil war and Polish invasion.
russia.summary_zh: 伊凡雷帝加冕为沙皇并征服喀山；其世系断绝后，混乱时期带来内战与波兰入侵。

russia.name: Early Romanovs
russia.summary: The Romanov dynasty restored order, imposed serfdom and expanded across Siberia to the Pacific.
russia.summary_zh: 罗曼诺夫王朝恢复秩序，确立农奴制，并穿越西伯利亚扩张至太平洋。

russia.name: Peter the Great and Successors
russia.summary: Peter the Great westernised Russia, built St Petersburg and proclaimed the Russian Empire after defeating Sweden.
russia.summary_zh: 彼得大帝推行西化，建造圣彼得堡，并在战胜瑞典后宣布成立俄罗斯帝国。

russia.name: Catherine and Imperial Zenith
russia.name_zh: 叶卡捷琳娜与帝国鼎盛
russia.summary: Catherine the Great expanded to the Black Sea and Poland, and Russia defeated Napoleon to become Europe's gendarme.
russia.summary_zh: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝扩张至黑海并瓜分波兰，俄国击败拿破仑，成为“欧洲宪兵”。

russia.name: Reform and Late Empire
russia.summary: After the Crimean defeat Alexander II freed the serfs; industrialisation, revolutionary movements and the 1905 revolution followed.
russia.summary_zh: 克里米亚战败后亚历山大二世解放农奴，随之而来的是工业化、革命运动与1905年革命。

russia.name: Revolution and Civil War
russia.summary: The tsar fell in February 1917, the Bolsheviks seized power in October and won the ensuing civil war.
russia.summary_zh: 1917年二月沙皇倒台，布尔什维克于十月夺取政权，并赢得随后的内战。

russia.name: Soviet Union
russia.summary: The USSR built a one-party state, forced industrialisation under Stalin, won the Second World War and contested the Cold War.
russia.summary_zh: 苏联建立一党制国家，斯大林时期强制工业化，赢得二战并与美国进行冷战。

russia.name: Russian Federation
russia.summary: After the Soviet collapse Russia went through turbulent market reforms, then a centralised state under Putin.
russia.summary_zh: 苏联解体后俄罗斯经历动荡的市场化改革，随后在普京领导下走向中央集权。

austria.name: Habsburg Duchy of Austria
austria.summary: Rudolf I granted Austria to his sons, making it the core territory of the Habsburg dynasty.
austria.summary_zh: 鲁道夫一世将奥地利授予其子，奥地利由此成为哈布斯堡家族的核心领地。

austria.name: Archduchy and Imperial Habsburgs
austria.summary: Raised to an archduchy, Austria's rulers held the imperial crown and gained Burgundy and Spain through marriages.
austria.summary_zh: 奥地利升为大公国，其统治者占据神圣罗马皇位，并通过联姻获得勃艮第与西班牙。

austria.name: Habsburg Monarchy and Turkish Wars
austria.name_zh: 哈布斯堡君主国与对土战争
austria.summary: Gaining Bohemia and Hungary, the Austrian Habsburgs resisted the Ottomans, surviving the sieges of Vienna in 1529 and 1683.
austria.summary_zh: 奥地利哈布斯堡获得波希米亚与匈牙利，抵抗奥斯曼帝国，经受住1529年和1683年两次维也纳之围。

austria.name: Baroque Great Power
austria.name_zh: 巴洛克强国与玛丽亚·特蕾莎
austria.summary: Austria became a great power stretching into the Balkans; Maria Theresa and Joseph II reformed the state.
austria.summary_zh: 奥地利成为延伸至巴尔干的大国；玛丽亚·特蕾莎与约瑟夫二世推行国家改革。

austria.name: Austrian Empire
austria.summary: Francis I proclaimed the Austrian Empire; under Metternich it led conservative Europe until defeat by Prussia in 1866.
austria.summary_zh: 弗朗茨一世宣布建立奥地利帝国；在梅特涅主导下领衔保守的欧洲，直至1866年败于普鲁士。

austria.name: Austria-Hungary
austria.summary: The Compromise created a dual monarchy with Hungary, a multinational empire that collapsed after the First World War.
austria.summary_zh: 《奥匈协定》建立奥匈二元君主国，这一多民族帝国在一战后瓦解。

austria.name: First Austrian Republic
austria.summary: A small German-speaking republic struggled economically and slid into the authoritarian Austrofascist state.
austria.summary_zh: 讲德语的小共和国经济困顿，逐渐滑向威权的“奥地利法西斯”政体。

austria.name: Anschluss
austria.summary: Nazi Germany annexed Austria, which shared in the Second World War and the Holocaust.
austria.summary_zh: 纳粹德国吞并奥地利，奥地利卷入第二次世界大战与大屠杀。

austria.name: Second Austrian Republic
austria.summary: After Allied occupation Austria regained sovereignty in 1955 as a neutral state and joined the EU in 1995.
austria.summary_zh: 经过盟军占领，奥地利于1955年以中立国身份恢复主权，1995年加入欧盟。

hungary.name: Hungarian Conquest
hungary.summary: Magyar tribes under Árpád settled the Carpathian Basin and raided Europe until their defeat at Lechfeld in 955.
hungary.summary_zh: 阿尔帕德率领马扎尔部落定居喀尔巴阡盆地，四处劫掠欧洲，直至955年在莱希费尔德战败。

hungary.name: Árpád Kingdom
hungary.summary: Saint Stephen was crowned the first Christian king, and the kingdom survived the Mongol invasion of 1241.
hungary.summary_zh: 圣伊什特万加冕为第一位基督教国王，王国熬过了1241年蒙古入侵。

hungary.name: Angevin and Luxembourg Kings
hungary.name_zh: 安茹王朝与卢森堡王朝
hungary.summary: Angevin and Luxembourg kings made Hungary a major Central European power as the Ottoman threat grew.
hungary.summary_zh: 安茹与卢森堡王朝的国王使匈牙利成为中欧强国，而奥斯曼的威胁日益加剧。

hungary.name: Matthias Corvinus and Jagiellonians
hungary.summary: Matthias Corvinus built a Renaissance court and a strong army, but the kingdom weakened under the Jagiellonians.
hungary.summary_zh: 马加什一世建立文艺复兴宫廷和强大军队，但王国在雅盖隆王朝治下日渐衰弱。

hungary.name: Ottoman Partition
hungary.summary: After defeat at Mohács, Hungary was split between the Habsburgs, the Ottomans and the principality of Transylvania.
hungary.summary_zh: 莫哈奇战败后，匈牙利被哈布斯堡、奥斯曼帝国与特兰西瓦尼亚公国三分。

hungary.name: Habsburg Hungary
hungary.name_zh: 哈布斯堡统治下的匈牙利
hungary.summary: The Habsburgs reconquered all of Hungary, which kept its diet and nobility amid a national reform movement.
hungary.summary_zh: 哈布斯堡收复匈牙利全境，匈牙利保留了议会与贵族特权，民族改革运动兴起。

hungary.name: Revolution and Absolutism
hungary.summary: The 1848 revolution and war of independence were crushed with Russian help, followed by neo-absolutist rule from Vienna.
hungary.summary_zh: 1848年革命与独立战争在俄国干预下被镇压，随后维也纳推行新专制统治。

hungary.name: Dual Monarchy
hungary.summary: The Compromise made Hungary an equal partner in Austria-Hungary, and Budapest flourished until defeat in 1918.
hungary.summary_zh: 《奥匈协定》使匈牙利成为奥匈帝国的平等伙伴，布达佩斯繁荣至1918年战败。

hungary.name: Horthy Era
hungary.summary: After a brief Soviet republic, Admiral Horthy's regency lost two-thirds of the kingdom at Trianon and allied with Germany.
hungary.summary_zh: 短暂的苏维埃共和国之后，霍尔蒂海军上将摄政，《特里亚农条约》使王国丧失三分之二领土，后与德国结盟。

hungary.name: Communist Hungary
hungary.summary: Soviet-backed communists took power; the 1956 uprising was crushed, followed by Kádár's "goulash communism".
hungary.summary_zh: 苏联扶植的共产党掌权；1956年起义遭镇压，其后是卡达尔的“土豆烧牛肉共产主义”。

hungary.name: Republic of Hungary
hungary.summary: Hungary became a multiparty democracy, joined NATO and the EU, and later drifted toward illiberal politics.
hungary.summary_zh: 匈牙利成为多党民主国家，加入北约和欧盟，后来走向“非自由民主”。

poland.name: Early Piast Monarchy
poland.summary: Mieszko I's baptism in 966 founded a Christian Polish state, which Bolesław the Brave raised to a kingdom.
poland.summary_zh: 梅什科一世于966年受洗，建立起基督教波兰国家，勇敢者波列斯瓦夫将其升格为王国。

poland.name: Period of Fragmentation
poland.summary: Bolesław III's testament split Poland among his sons into rival duchies, while the Mongols raided and the Teutonic Knights settled on the Baltic.
poland.summary_zh: 波列斯瓦夫三世的遗嘱将波兰分给诸子，形成互相争斗的公国；蒙古入侵，条顿骑士团在波罗的海沿岸立足。

poland.name: Reunited Kingdom (Late Piasts)
poland.summary: Władysław the Short reunited the crown and Casimir the Great rebuilt the kingdom with new laws, towns and the Kraków university.
poland.summary_zh: 矮子瓦迪斯瓦夫重新统一王冠，卡齐米日大王以新法、新城和克拉科夫大学重建王国。

poland.name: Jagiellonian Era
poland.summary: Union with Lithuania under Jogaila made Poland a great power that defeated the Teutonic Order and enjoyed a Renaissance golden age, ending in the 1569 Union of Lublin.
poland.summary_zh: 通过与立陶宛联合，雅盖沃使波兰成为强国，击败条顿骑士团，迎来文艺复兴黄金时代，并于1569年缔结卢布林联合。

poland.name: Elective Monarchy of the Commonwealth
poland.name_zh: 波兰立陶宛联邦选王制时期
poland.summary: The nobility elected its kings and guarded its liberties; after wars like the Swedish Deluge the weakened Commonwealth was partitioned out of existence by its neighbours.
poland.summary_zh: 贵族选举国王、捍卫特权；经历瑞典“大洪水”等战争后，衰弱的联邦被邻国三次瓜分而灭亡。

poland.name: Partitioned Poland
poland.summary: With no state of their own, Poles lived under Russia, Prussia and Austria, rising repeatedly in 1830 and 1863 and keeping the nation alive through culture.
poland.summary_zh: 波兰人没有自己的国家，分属俄、普、奥统治，在1830年和1863年多次起义，并以文化维系民族认同。

poland.name: Second Polish Republic
poland.summary: Poland regained independence in 1918, won the war against Soviet Russia and was dominated by Józef Piłsudski.
poland.summary_zh: 波兰于1918年恢复独立，在对苏俄战争中获胜，政局长期由毕苏斯基主导。

poland.name: Occupation in World War II
poland.summary: Germany and the USSR invaded in 1939; occupation brought the Holocaust, mass murder of Poles and the Warsaw Uprising.
poland.summary_zh: 1939年德国和苏联入侵；占领期间发生了大屠杀、对波兰人的大规模屠杀以及华沙起义。

poland.name: Polish People's Republic
poland.summary: A Soviet-aligned communist state with shifted borders, shaken by crises in 1956, 1970 and 1980 that gave rise to Solidarity.
poland.summary_zh: 边界西移的亲苏社会主义国家，1956、1970、1980年的危机催生了团结工会运动。

poland.name: Third Polish Republic
poland.summary: Round Table talks ended communism in 1989; Poland built a market democracy and joined NATO and the EU.
poland.summary_zh: 1989年圆桌会谈结束了共产党统治，波兰建立市场经济民主国家，并加入北约和欧盟。

sweden.name: Early Swedish Kingdom
sweden.summary: Kings such as Eric the Victorious and Olof Skötkonung united Svear and Götar and slowly converted Sweden to Christianity.
sweden.summary_zh: 胜利者埃里克和奥洛夫·舍特康努格等国王联合了斯韦阿人和约特人，瑞典逐步皈依基督教。

sweden.name: Folkung (Bjälbo) Era
sweden.summary: Birger Jarl's house built a stronger crown, founded Stockholm and issued the first national law code.
sweden.summary_zh: 比耶尔·雅尔家族加强王权，建立斯德哥尔摩，颁布了第一部全国法典。

sweden.name: Kalmar Union
sweden.summary: Sweden shared a monarch with Denmark and Norway, resisting Danish dominance until the Stockholm Bloodbath sparked revolt.
sweden.summary_zh: 瑞典与丹麦、挪威共奉一君，不断反抗丹麦的主导，直到斯德哥尔摩惨案引发起义。

sweden.name: Early Vasa Era
sweden.summary: Gustav Vasa broke from the union, made the crown hereditary and brought the Lutheran Reformation to Sweden.
sweden.summary_zh: 古斯塔夫·瓦萨脱离联盟，确立王位世袭，并在瑞典推行路德宗宗教改革。

sweden.name: Swedish Empire (Great Power Era)
sweden.summary: Gustavus Adolphus and his heirs made Sweden master of the Baltic until defeat in the Great Northern War.
sweden.summary_zh: 古斯塔夫·阿道夫及其继承者使瑞典称霸波罗的海，直到在大北方战争中失败。

sweden.name: Age of Liberty
sweden.summary: After absolutism collapsed, power passed to the Riksdag and its rival Hats and Caps parties.
sweden.summary_zh: 专制崩溃后，权力转归议会及其相互竞争的“礼帽党”与“便帽党”。

sweden.name: Gustavian Era
sweden.summary: Gustav III's coup restored royal power and a brilliant Enlightenment culture, until the loss of Finland in 1809.
sweden.summary_zh: 古斯塔夫三世的政变恢复了王权，启蒙文化繁荣，直到1809年失去芬兰。

sweden.name: Early Bernadotte Era and Union with Norway
sweden.name_zh: 贝纳多特王朝早期与瑞挪联合
sweden.summary: A French marshal founded the Bernadotte dynasty; Sweden ruled Norway in personal union and began to industrialise.
sweden.summary_zh: 一位法国元帅开创贝纳多特王朝；瑞典与挪威结成共主联邦，并开始工业化。

sweden.name: Democratic Breakthrough
sweden.summary: Universal suffrage and parliamentary rule were established while Sweden stayed neutral in World War I.
sweden.summary_zh: 瑞典确立了普选和议会制，并在第一次世界大战中保持中立。

sweden.name: Folkhemmet: Social Democratic Era
sweden.summary: Long Social Democratic rule built a model welfare state, while Sweden stayed neutral through World War II and the Cold War.
sweden.summary_zh: 社会民主党长期执政，建立起典范式福利国家，瑞典在二战和冷战中保持中立。

sweden.name: Contemporary Sweden
sweden.summary: After a financial crisis Sweden reformed its welfare model, joined the EU in 1995 and NATO in 2024.
sweden.summary_zh: 金融危机后瑞典改革福利模式，1995年加入欧盟，2024年加入北约。

denmark.name: Jelling Dynasty
denmark.summary: Gorm the Old and Harald Bluetooth united and christianised Denmark; Cnut the Great ruled a North Sea empire.
denmark.summary_zh: 老戈姆和蓝牙哈拉尔统一丹麦并使其皈依基督教；克努特大帝统治北海帝国。

denmark.name: Early Estridsen Era
denmark.name_zh: 埃斯特里德森王朝早期
denmark.summary: Sweyn Estridsen's sons built church and crown, before the kingdom sank into civil war.
denmark.summary_zh: 斯文·埃斯特里德森的诸子建设教会和王权，随后王国陷入内战。

denmark.name: Valdemarian Era
denmark.summary: Valdemar the Great and his sons made Denmark the leading Baltic power and codified the Jutland Law.
denmark.summary_zh: 瓦尔德马大王及其子使丹麦成为波罗的海头号强国，并编订了《日德兰法典》。

denmark.name: Era of Decline
denmark.summary: Royal power crumbled to the nobles and German counts, culminating in a kingless interregnum.
denmark.summary_zh: 王权落入贵族和德意志伯爵之手，最终出现无王空位期。

denmark.name: Restoration under Valdemar IV and Margaret
denmark.name_zh: 瓦尔德马四世与玛格丽特复兴
denmark.summary: Valdemar Atterdag bought back the realm and Queen Margaret united the three Nordic crowns.
denmark.summary_zh: 瓦尔德马·阿特达格赎回国土，玛格丽特女王统一了北欧三国王冠。

denmark.name: Kalmar Union
denmark.summary: Denmark led a union of Denmark, Norway and Sweden under one monarch until Sweden broke away.
denmark.summary_zh: 丹麦主导丹麦、挪威、瑞典的共主联盟，直到瑞典脱离。

denmark.name: Reformation and Aristocratic Monarchy
denmark.name_zh: 宗教改革与贵族君主制时期
denmark.summary: The Oldenburg kings adopted Lutheranism and shared power with the nobility, while wars with Sweden cost Denmark its eastern lands.
denmark.summary_zh: 奥尔登堡王朝国王改宗路德宗并与贵族分享权力，与瑞典的战争使丹麦失去东部领土。

denmark.name: Age of Absolutism
denmark.summary: Frederick III made the crown hereditary and absolute; later came agrarian reform and the loss of Norway in 1814.
denmark.summary_zh: 弗雷德里克三世确立世袭专制王权；其后推行土地改革，1814年失去挪威。

denmark.name: Constitutional Monarchy
denmark.summary: The 1849 constitution ended absolutism; Denmark lost Schleswig-Holstein in 1864 and became a parliamentary democracy.
denmark.summary_zh: 1849年宪法结束了专制；丹麦在1864年失去石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因，逐步成为议会民主国家。

denmark.name: German Occupation
denmark.summary: Germany occupied Denmark in 1940; resistance grew and most Danish Jews were rescued to Sweden in 1943.
denmark.summary_zh: 1940年德国占领丹麦；抵抗运动壮大，1943年大部分丹麦犹太人被救往瑞典。

denmark.name: Welfare State
denmark.summary: Denmark joined NATO and the EEC and built a comprehensive Nordic welfare state.
denmark.summary_zh: 丹麦加入北约和欧洲经济共同体，建立了全面的北欧福利国家。

netherlands.name: Dutch Revolt
netherlands.summary: The northern provinces abjured Philip II in 1581 and fought Spain for independence under the House of Orange.
netherlands.summary_zh: 北方诸省于1581年废黜腓力二世，在奥兰治家族领导下对西班牙进行独立战争。

netherlands.name: Dutch Golden Age
netherlands.summary: The Republic became the world's leading trading nation through the VOC, with Amsterdam a centre of finance, science and art.
netherlands.summary_zh: 共和国凭借荷兰东印度公司成为世界头号贸易国，阿姆斯特丹成为金融、科学和艺术中心。

netherlands.name: Later Republic (Periwig Era)
netherlands.summary: After the Disaster Year of 1672 the Republic held off France but slowly lost its economic and naval lead.
netherlands.summary_zh: 1672年“灾难之年”后，共和国抵挡住法国，但经济和海上优势逐渐丧失。

netherlands.name: Patriot Era
netherlands.summary: Defeat by Britain fuelled a democratic Patriot movement against the Stadtholder, crushed by Prussian intervention in 1787.
netherlands.summary_zh: 败于英国激发了反对执政的民主“爱国者”运动，1787年被普鲁士干涉镇压。

netherlands.name: Batavian Republic and French Rule
netherlands.name_zh: 巴达维亚共和国与法国统治
netherlands.summary: French armies created the Batavian Republic, which became a Bonapartist kingdom and then part of France.
netherlands.summary_zh: 法军扶植巴达维亚共和国，后改为波拿巴家族的王国，最终并入法国。

netherlands.name: United Kingdom of the Netherlands
netherlands.summary: William I ruled the Low Countries as one kingdom until Belgium broke away in 1830.
netherlands.summary_zh: 威廉一世统治包括低地全境的联合王国，直到1830年比利时独立。

netherlands.name: Constitutional Kingdom
netherlands.summary: Thorbecke's 1848 constitution created parliamentary rule; a neutral, pillarised society grew rich from industry and the colonies.
netherlands.summary_zh: 托尔贝克1848年宪法确立议会制；中立且“柱状化”的社会依靠工业和殖民地日益富裕。

netherlands.name: German Occupation
netherlands.summary: Germany conquered the Netherlands in 1940; most Dutch Jews were murdered and the 1944–45 Hunger Winter struck the west.
netherlands.summary_zh: 1940年德国征服荷兰；大部分荷兰犹太人遇害，1944至1945年西部遭遇“饥饿之冬”。

netherlands.name: Postwar Netherlands
netherlands.summary: The Netherlands lost Indonesia, co-founded NATO and the European Communities, and built a welfare state.
netherlands.summary_zh: 荷兰失去印度尼西亚，参与创建北约和欧洲共同体，并建成福利国家。

byzantium.name: Theodosian Dynasty
byzantium.summary: After the empire's final division, Constantinople gained its great land walls and the Theodosian law code.
byzantium.summary_zh: 帝国最终分裂后，君士坦丁堡修建了宏伟的陆墙，并编成《狄奥多西法典》。

byzantium.name: Leonid Dynasty
byzantium.summary: The East survived the fall of the West in 476; Zeno and Anastasius stabilised the treasury.
byzantium.summary_zh: 东部帝国在476年西部灭亡后幸存，芝诺和阿纳斯塔修斯稳定了国库。

byzantium.name: Justinian Dynasty
byzantium.summary: Justinian codified Roman law, built Hagia Sophia and reconquered Italy and Africa, but plague and wars exhausted the empire.
byzantium.summary_zh: 查士丁尼编纂罗马法、建造圣索菲亚大教堂并收复意大利和北非，但瘟疫与战争耗尽了国力。

byzantium.name: Heraclian Dynasty
byzantium.summary: Heraclius defeated Persia but the Arab conquests took Syria and Egypt, leaving a smaller Greek-speaking state.
byzantium.summary_zh: 希拉克略击败波斯，但阿拉伯征服夺走叙利亚和埃及，帝国缩小为讲希腊语的国家。

byzantium.name: Isaurian Dynasty and Iconoclasm
byzantium.name_zh: 伊苏里亚王朝与圣像破坏运动
byzantium.summary: Leo III repelled the Arab siege of Constantinople and launched the controversy over religious images.
byzantium.summary_zh: 利奥三世击退阿拉伯人对君士坦丁堡的围攻，并发起圣像之争。

byzantium.name: Nikephorian and Amorian Era
byzantium.name_zh: 尼基弗鲁斯与阿莫里亚王朝
byzantium.summary: The empire weathered Bulgar and Arab wars, ended Iconoclasm in 843 and sent Cyril and Methodius to the Slavs.
byzantium.summary_zh: 帝国经受保加尔人和阿拉伯人的战争，843年终结圣像破坏运动，并派西里尔和美多德向斯拉夫人传教。

byzantium.name: Macedonian Dynasty
byzantium.summary: A cultural renaissance and military revival culminated in Basil II's conquest of Bulgaria.
byzantium.summary_zh: 文化复兴与军事振兴并进，在巴西尔二世征服保加利亚时达到顶峰。

byzantium.name: Eleventh-Century Crisis
byzantium.summary: Civil strife, the 1054 schism's aftermath and defeat by the Seljuks at Manzikert in 1071 cost the empire Anatolia.
byzantium.summary_zh: 内乱不断，加之1071年曼齐刻尔特之战败于塞尔柱人，帝国失去安纳托利亚。

byzantium.name: Komnenian Dynasty
byzantium.summary: Alexios I and his heirs restored Byzantine power with Crusader help and family-based rule.
byzantium.summary_zh: 阿历克塞一世及其继承者借助十字军和家族统治恢复了拜占庭的实力。

byzantium.name: Angelos Dynasty
byzantium.summary: Weak emperors lost Bulgaria and Cyprus and their quarrels drew the Fourth Crusade to Constantinople.
byzantium.summary_zh: 软弱的皇帝失去保加利亚和塞浦路斯，其内斗将第四次十字军引向君士坦丁堡。

byzantium.name: Latin Conquest and Empire of Nicaea
byzantium.name_zh: 拉丁帝国与尼西亚流亡时期
byzantium.summary: Crusaders sacked Constantinople in 1204; Byzantine rule continued in exile at Nicaea.
byzantium.summary_zh: 十字军于1204年洗劫君士坦丁堡；拜占庭政权流亡尼西亚延续。

byzantium.name: Palaiologan Dynasty
byzantium.summary: Michael VIII recovered Constantinople, but civil wars and the Ottomans shrank the empire until the city fell in 1453.
byzantium.summary_zh: 米海尔八世收复君士坦丁堡，但内战和奥斯曼人使帝国不断缩小，直至1453年城陷。

ottoman.name: Rise of the Ottoman State
ottoman.summary: Osman's frontier beylik expanded into the Balkans, winning at Kosovo in 1389 before Timur crushed it at Ankara.
ottoman.summary_zh: 奥斯曼的边境侯国扩张至巴尔干，1389年赢得科索沃之战，随后在安卡拉被帖木儿击溃。

ottoman.name: Ottoman Interregnum
ottoman.summary: Bayezid I's sons fought a civil war over the remnants of the state after his capture by Timur.
ottoman.summary_zh: 巴耶济德一世被帖木儿俘虏后，诸子为争夺残余国土展开内战。

ottoman.name: Restoration
ottoman.summary: Mehmed I and Murad II reunited the realm and pushed back crusading armies at Varna.
ottoman.summary_zh: 穆罕默德一世和穆拉德二世重新统一国家，并在瓦尔纳击退十字军。

ottoman.name: Classical Age
ottoman.summary: The conquest of Constantinople opened an age of expansion under Selim I and Suleiman the Magnificent.
ottoman.summary_zh: 攻占君士坦丁堡开启扩张时代，塞利姆一世和苏莱曼大帝时期达于鼎盛。

ottoman.name: Age of Transformation
ottoman.summary: Power shifted from the sultans to viziers and the palace; the Köprülü revival ended with defeat at Vienna in 1683.
ottoman.summary_zh: 权力从苏丹转向大维齐尔和宫廷；柯普吕律家族的中兴以1683年维也纳之败告终。

ottoman.name: Tulip Era
ottoman.summary: A peaceful, pleasure-loving court opened to European taste and brought the first Ottoman printing press.
ottoman.summary_zh: 和平享乐的宫廷开始接受欧洲风尚，并引进了第一台奥斯曼印刷机。

ottoman.name: Age of Ayans and Early Reform
ottoman.name_zh: 地方显贵与早期改革时期
ottoman.summary: Losses to Russia and the rise of provincial notables prompted Selim III and Mahmud II's military reforms.
ottoman.summary_zh: 对俄战败和地方显贵崛起促使塞利姆三世和马哈茂德二世推行军事改革。

ottoman.name: Tanzimat Era
ottoman.summary: Edicts reorganised law, administration and education and declared equality of all subjects.
ottoman.summary_zh: 一系列敕令重整法律、行政和教育，并宣布所有臣民一律平等。

ottoman.name: Hamidian Era
ottoman.summary: Abdülhamid II suspended the first constitution and ruled autocratically through pan-Islamic policy.
ottoman.summary_zh: 阿卜杜勒-哈米德二世中止第一部宪法，以泛伊斯兰主义实行专制统治。

ottoman.name: Second Constitutional Era
ottoman.summary: The Young Turks restored the constitution, but Balkan wars, World War I and the Armenian genocide ended the empire.
ottoman.summary_zh: 青年土耳其党恢复宪法，但巴尔干战争、第一次世界大战和亚美尼亚大屠杀导致帝国灭亡。

ottoman.name: Kemalist Single-Party Republic
ottoman.summary: Atatürk's republic abolished the caliphate and imposed secular, Westernising reforms.
ottoman.summary_zh: 阿塔图尔克的共和国废除哈里发制度，推行世俗化和西化改革。

ottoman.name: Multi-Party Republic
ottoman.summary: Turkey joined NATO and alternated between elected governments and military coups, with Erdoğan dominant after 2002.
ottoman.summary_zh: 土耳其加入北约，民选政府与军事政变交替，2002年后埃尔多安居于主导地位。

iran.name: Afsharid Dynasty
iran.summary: Nader Shah ended Safavid rule and conquered from Delhi to the Caucasus, but his empire broke up after his murder.
iran.summary_zh: 纳迪尔沙终结萨非王朝，征服范围从德里延至高加索，但他遇刺后帝国瓦解。

iran.name: Zand Dynasty
iran.summary: Karim Khan Zand ruled most of Iran peacefully from Shiraz as regent rather than shah.
iran.summary_zh: 卡里姆汗·赞德以摄政而非国王的名义，自设拉子和平统治伊朗大部分地区。

iran.name: Qajar Dynasty
iran.summary: The Qajars made Tehran the capital but lost the Caucasus to Russia and fell under Anglo-Russian influence.
iran.summary_zh: 恺加王朝定都德黑兰，但把高加索地区割让给俄国，并受英俄两国势力左右。

iran.name: Constitutional Revolution Era
iran.summary: The 1906 revolution created a parliament, but foreign occupation and disorder weakened the late Qajar state.
iran.summary_zh: 1906年革命建立了议会，但外国占领和动乱使恺加王朝后期国力衰微。

iran.name: Reza Shah Pahlavi
iran.name_zh: 巴列维王朝礼萨·沙时期
iran.summary: Reza Shah founded the Pahlavi dynasty and pushed centralising, secular modernisation.
iran.summary_zh: 礼萨·沙建立巴列维王朝，推行中央集权和世俗化的现代化。

iran.name: Mohammad Reza Shah
iran.name_zh: 巴列维王朝穆罕默德·礼萨·沙时期
iran.summary: After the 1953 coup against Mosaddegh the Shah ruled autocratically with oil wealth and the White Revolution.
iran.summary_zh: 1953年推翻摩萨台的政变后，国王凭借石油财富和“白色革命”实行专制统治。

iran.name: Revolution and Iran–Iraq War
iran.name_zh: 伊斯兰革命与两伊战争时期
iran.summary: Khomeini's revolution founded the Islamic Republic, which then fought an eight-year war with Iraq.
iran.summary_zh: 霍梅尼领导的革命建立伊斯兰共和国，随后与伊拉克进行了八年战争。

iran.name: Islamic Republic under Khamenei
iran.name_zh: 哈梅内伊时期的伊斯兰共和国
iran.summary: Under Supreme Leader Khamenei, reformist and hardline factions contested power amid nuclear disputes and sanctions.
iran.summary_zh: 在最高领袖哈梅内伊治下，改革派与强硬派在核争端和制裁中角力。

khmer.name: Chenla
khmer.summary: Khmer kingdoms of Chenla replaced Funan, later splitting into Land and Water Chenla.
khmer.summary_zh: 真腊的高棉王国取代扶南，后分裂为陆真腊和水真腊。

khmer.name: Early Angkor
khmer.summary: Jayavarman II proclaimed himself universal monarch in 802 and his successors built a capital and reservoirs at Angkor.
khmer.summary_zh: 阇耶跋摩二世于802年自立为转轮王，其继承者在吴哥营建都城和水库。

khmer.name: Age of Angkor Wat
khmer.summary: Suryavarman II built Angkor Wat and campaigned against Champa and Dai Viet; later the Chams sacked Angkor.
khmer.summary_zh: 苏耶跋摩二世建造吴哥窟并征伐占婆和大越；其后占婆人洗劫吴哥。

khmer.name: Reign of Jayavarman VII
khmer.summary: The Buddhist king Jayavarman VII drove out the Chams and built Angkor Thom, the Bayon and a network of hospitals and roads.
khmer.summary_zh: 佛教君主阇耶跋摩七世驱逐占婆人，修建吴哥城、巴戎寺以及医院和道路网。

khmer.name: Late Angkor
khmer.summary: Theravada Buddhism spread and Angkor slowly declined under pressure from the rising Thai kingdoms.
khmer.summary_zh: 上座部佛教传播开来，吴哥在崛起的泰人王国压力下逐渐衰落。

khmer.name: Post-Angkor Period
khmer.summary: After Ayutthaya took Angkor the court moved south to Longvek and Oudong, squeezed between Siam and Vietnam.
khmer.summary_zh: 阿瑜陀耶攻陷吴哥后，王廷南迁至洛韦和乌栋，夹在暹罗与越南之间。

khmer.name: French Protectorate
khmer.summary: Cambodia became a French protectorate and part of French Indochina.
khmer.summary_zh: 柬埔寨成为法国保护国，并入法属印度支那。

khmer.name: Sihanouk's Kingdom (Sangkum)
khmer.summary: Norodom Sihanouk won independence in 1953 and ruled through his Sangkum movement, trying to stay neutral in the Vietnam War.
khmer.summary_zh: 诺罗敦·西哈努克于1953年争取到独立，通过“人民社会同盟”执政，力图在越战中保持中立。

khmer.name: Khmer Republic
khmer.summary: Lon Nol's coup created a US-backed republic engulfed in civil war and bombing.
khmer.summary_zh: 朗诺发动政变建立亲美共和国，国家陷入内战和轰炸。

khmer.name: Democratic Kampuchea (Khmer Rouge)
khmer.summary: Pol Pot's regime emptied the cities and killed about a quarter of the population.
khmer.summary_zh: 波尔布特政权驱空城市，造成约四分之一人口死亡。

khmer.name: People's Republic of Kampuchea
khmer.summary: Vietnam ousted the Khmer Rouge and backed a new government amid continuing guerrilla war, ending with the 1991 Paris accords.
khmer.summary_zh: 越南推翻红色高棉并扶植新政府，游击战持续，直至1991年《巴黎和平协定》。

khmer.name: Kingdom of Cambodia
khmer.summary: UN-run elections restored the monarchy; Hun Sen's party came to dominate politics.
khmer.summary_zh: 联合国主持的选举恢复了君主制；洪森的政党逐渐主导政局。

siam.name: Thonburi Kingdom
siam.summary: After Ayutthaya fell to Burma, Taksin drove out the invaders and reunited Siam from Thonburi.
siam.summary_zh: 阿瑜陀耶被缅甸攻灭后，郑信驱逐入侵者，以吞武里为都重新统一暹罗。

siam.name: Early Rattanakosin
siam.summary: Rama I founded the Chakri dynasty at Bangkok and rebuilt Siamese power on the Ayutthaya model.
siam.summary_zh: 拉玛一世在曼谷建立却克里王朝，仿照阿瑜陀耶重建暹罗国力。

siam.name: Era of Modernising Reform
siam.summary: Mongkut and Chulalongkorn opened Siam to trade, centralised the state and kept it independent by ceding border lands.
siam.summary_zh: 蒙固王和朱拉隆功开放通商、集中国家权力，并以割让边地保持了独立。

siam.name: Late Absolute Monarchy
siam.summary: Vajiravudh promoted Thai nationalism while Prajadhipok struggled with financial crisis.
siam.summary_zh: 瓦栖拉兀倡导泰国民族主义，巴差提步则苦于财政危机。

siam.name: Constitutional Revolution and Phibun Era
siam.name_zh: 立宪革命与銮披汶时期
siam.summary: The 1932 revolution ended absolute monarchy; Phibun's nationalist regime renamed the country Thailand and allied with Japan.
siam.summary_zh: 1932年革命结束绝对君主制；銮披汶的民族主义政权将国名改为泰国，并与日本结盟。

siam.name: Military Development Era
siam.summary: Sarit and Thanom ruled as US-backed military strongmen, boosting development and the monarchy's prestige.
siam.summary_zh: 沙立和他侬以美国支持的军人强人身份统治，推动发展并提升王室威望。

siam.name: Democratic Turmoil
siam.summary: The 1973 uprising opened a democratic interlude ended by the 1976 massacre; semi-democracy followed under Prem.
siam.summary_zh: 1973年起义开启民主插曲，1976年屠杀将其终结，随后炳执政时期实行半民主。

siam.name: Era of Parliamentary Democracy
siam.summary: After Black May 1992 Thailand adopted the 1997 constitution, endured the Asian financial crisis and saw Thaksin's rise.
siam.summary_zh: 1992年“黑色五月”后，泰国通过1997年宪法，经历亚洲金融危机，他信崛起。

siam.name: Era of Coups and Polarisation
siam.summary: Coups in 2006 and 2014 and yellow-red street battles kept the military and royalist establishment in control.
siam.summary_zh: 2006年和2014年政变以及黄衫军与红衫军的对抗，使军方和保皇派继续掌控大局。

ethiopia.name: Early Solomonic Dynasty
ethiopia.summary: Yekuno Amlak restored the line claiming descent from Solomon, and Amda Seyon expanded the Christian highland kingdom.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 耶库诺·阿姆拉克恢复自称所罗门后裔的王统，阿姆达·塞永扩张了高原基督教王国。

ethiopia.name: Height of the Medieval Kingdom
ethiopia.summary: Zara Yaqob reformed the church and centralised royal power, and the kingdom reached its medieval height.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 扎拉·雅各布改革教会、强化王权，王国达到中世纪鼎盛。

ethiopia.name: Adal War
ethiopia.summary: Imam Ahmad Gragn of Adal overran most of the highlands until Portuguese help restored the kingdom.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 阿达尔的伊玛目艾哈迈德·格兰攻占大部分高原，直到葡萄牙援军帮助王国复国。

ethiopia.name: Oromo Migrations and Recovery
ethiopia.name_zh: 奥罗莫迁徙与复兴时期
ethiopia.summary: Oromo migrations reshaped the south while kings like Sarsa Dengel and Susenyos rebuilt the state, the latter briefly turning Catholic.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 奥罗莫人迁徙重塑了南部格局，萨尔萨·丹格尔和苏斯尼约斯等国王重建国家，后者一度改宗天主教。

ethiopia.name: Gondarine Period
ethiopia.summary: Fasilides expelled the Jesuits and built a permanent capital at Gondar, home to castles and a flourishing church culture.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 法西利达斯驱逐耶稣会士，在贡德尔建立固定都城，城堡林立，教会文化繁荣。

ethiopia.name: Zemene Mesafint (Era of the Princes)
ethiopia.summary: Emperors became puppets while regional warlords fought for control of the fragmented realm.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 皇帝沦为傀儡，地方军阀争夺四分五裂的国土。

ethiopia.name: Reunification under Tewodros and Yohannes
ethiopia.name_zh: 特沃德罗斯与约翰尼斯统一时期
ethiopia.summary: Tewodros II and Yohannes IV reunited the empire and fought British, Egyptian and Mahdist invaders.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 特沃德罗斯二世和约翰尼斯四世重新统一帝国，抵御英国、埃及和马赫迪军的入侵。

ethiopia.name: Reign of Menelik II
ethiopia.summary: Menelik II defeated Italy at Adwa in 1896, expanded the empire south and founded Addis Ababa.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 孟尼利克二世于1896年在阿杜瓦击败意大利，向南扩张帝国，并建立亚的斯亚贝巴。

ethiopia.name: Iyasu and Zewditu
ethiopia.summary: Lij Iyasu was deposed in 1916; Empress Zewditu reigned with Ras Tafari as regent and heir.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 利吉·伊亚苏于1916年被废黜；佐迪图女皇在位，塔法里亲王任摄政和储君。

ethiopia.name: Reign of Haile Selassie
ethiopia.summary: Haile Selassie modernised the autocracy, went into exile during the 1936–41 Italian occupation and returned as an African statesman.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 海尔·塞拉西推动专制体制现代化，1936至1941年意大利占领期间流亡，归国后成为非洲政治家。

ethiopia.name: Derg Regime
ethiopia.summary: A Marxist military junta under Mengistu overthrew the emperor, waged the Red Terror and suffered civil war and famine.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 门格斯图领导的马克思主义军政府推翻皇帝，实行“红色恐怖”，并经历内战和饥荒。

ethiopia.name: Federal Democratic Republic
ethiopia.summary: The EPRDF built an ethnic federal state; Eritrea seceded, and under Abiy Ahmed came reform and the Tigray war.
ethiopia.summary_zh: 埃塞俄比亚人民革命民主阵线建立民族联邦国家；厄立特里亚独立，阿比·艾哈迈德执政后推行改革并爆发提格雷战争。

egypt.name: Muhammad Ali's Egypt
egypt.summary: Muhammad Ali seized power as Ottoman governor and built a modern army, state monopolies and factories, making Egypt a regional power in all but name.
egypt.summary_zh: 穆罕默德·阿里出任奥斯曼总督后掌握实权，建立新式军队、国家专营和工厂，使埃及实际上成为地区强国。

egypt.name: Khedivate and Suez Canal
egypt.name_zh: 赫迪夫时代与苏伊士运河
egypt.summary: His successors opened the Suez Canal (1869) and pursued lavish Westernizing projects under Ismail, but debt brought European financial control.
egypt.summary_zh: 阿里的继任者开凿苏伊士运河（1869年），伊斯梅尔大举推行西化建设，但巨额债务导致欧洲列强控制埃及财政。

egypt.name: British Occupation
egypt.summary: Britain occupied Egypt after crushing the Urabi revolt, ruling behind the khedive and declaring a protectorate in 1914; the 1919 revolution demanded independence.
egypt.summary_zh: 英国镇压奥拉比起义后占领埃及，在赫迪夫背后实行统治，1914年宣布其为保护国；1919年革命要求独立。

egypt.name: Kingdom of Egypt
egypt.summary: Egypt gained nominal independence as a constitutional monarchy, but British troops, the palace and the Wafd party contested power until defeat in Palestine discredited the regime.
egypt.summary_zh: 埃及以君主立宪国的形式获得名义独立，但英军、王室与华夫脱党相互角力，巴勒斯坦战争的失败使王朝威信扫地。

egypt.name: Revolution and Nasser Era
egypt.name_zh: 七月革命与纳赛尔时代
egypt.summary: The Free Officers overthrew the king; Nasser nationalized the Suez Canal, championed Arab socialism and pan-Arabism, and suffered defeat in the 1967 war.
egypt.summary_zh: 自由军官组织推翻王室；纳赛尔将苏伊士运河收归国有，倡导阿拉伯社会主义和泛阿拉伯主义，并在1967年战争中失利。

egypt.name: Sadat Era
egypt.summary: Sadat launched the 1973 war, opened the economy to the West and made peace with Israel at Camp David, before his assassination in 1981.
egypt.summary_zh: 萨达特发动1973年战争，推行对西方的经济开放，并在戴维营与以色列媾和，1981年遇刺身亡。

egypt.name: Mubarak Era
egypt.summary: Mubarak ruled for three decades under emergency law, keeping close ties with the United States amid slow growth and rising discontent.
egypt.summary_zh: 穆巴拉克依靠紧急状态法统治近三十年，与美国保持密切关系，但经济增长缓慢、民怨日积。

egypt.name: 2011 Revolution and Aftermath
egypt.summary: Mass protests toppled Mubarak; the Muslim Brotherhood's Morsi won the presidency but was removed by the army in 2013.
egypt.summary_zh: 大规模抗议推翻穆巴拉克；穆斯林兄弟会的穆尔西当选总统，2013年被军方推翻。

egypt.name: Sisi Era
egypt.summary: Former army chief Sisi rules with a strong security state, pursuing megaprojects such as a new administrative capital amid economic strain.
egypt.summary_zh: 前军队统帅塞西以强力安全体制治国，推进新行政首都等大型工程，经济压力持续。

morocco.name: Rise of the Alaouites
morocco.summary: From their base in Tafilalt, the Alaouite sharifs fought rival powers after the Saadian collapse; Moulay Rashid took Fez and Marrakesh and reunited Morocco.
morocco.summary_zh: 萨阿德王朝崩溃后，阿拉维谢里夫家族以塔菲拉勒特为根据地与各方争雄；穆莱·拉希德攻取非斯和马拉喀什，重新统一摩洛哥。

morocco.name: Reign of Moulay Ismail
morocco.summary: Moulay Ismail built a powerful slave army and a grand capital at Meknes, recapturing coastal towns from Europeans in a long, forceful reign.
morocco.summary_zh: 穆莱·伊斯梅尔组建强大的黑人奴隶军，在梅克内斯营建宏伟都城，长期强势统治并从欧洲人手中收复沿海城镇。

morocco.name: Succession Crisis
morocco.summary: After Ismail's death his army made and unmade sultans, plunging the country into thirty years of civil strife.
morocco.summary_zh: 伊斯梅尔死后，军队擅行废立苏丹，国家陷入长达三十年的内乱。

morocco.name: Alaouite Restoration
morocco.summary: Mohammed III and Moulay Slimane restored order, founded Essaouira, traded with Europe and later turned inward.
morocco.summary_zh: 穆罕默德三世与穆莱·苏莱曼恢复秩序，兴建索维拉港并与欧洲通商，其后转向闭关自守。

morocco.name: Age of European Pressure
morocco.summary: Defeats by France (1844) and Spain (1860) and growing foreign debt undermined the sultanate despite reform efforts, ending in the Moroccan crises.
morocco.summary_zh: 摩洛哥先后败于法国（1844年）和西班牙（1860年），外债日增，改革无力回天，最终引发摩洛哥危机。

morocco.name: French and Spanish Protectorate
morocco.summary: The Treaty of Fez made Morocco a French protectorate with a Spanish zone in the north; the Rif War and nationalist movement challenged colonial rule.
morocco.summary_zh: 《非斯条约》使摩洛哥沦为法国保护国，北部划为西班牙区；里夫战争和民族主义运动挑战殖民统治。

morocco.name: Independence under Mohammed V
morocco.summary: Mohammed V, returned from exile as a national hero, led Morocco to independence and became king.
morocco.summary_zh: 从流亡中归来的民族英雄穆罕默德五世带领摩洛哥获得独立，并改称国王。

morocco.name: Reign of Hassan II
morocco.summary: Hassan II consolidated royal power through the repressive 'Years of Lead' and claimed Western Sahara with the 1975 Green March.
morocco.summary_zh: 哈桑二世在“铅之岁月”中以高压巩固王权，并通过1975年“绿色进军”宣称对西撒哈拉的主权。

morocco.name: Reign of Mohammed VI
morocco.summary: Mohammed VI pursued economic modernization, infrastructure and a 2011 constitutional reform while the monarchy kept decisive power.
morocco.summary_zh: 穆罕默德六世推动经济现代化和基础设施建设，2011年修宪，但王室仍掌握决定性权力。

usa.name: Revolution and Confederation
usa.summary: The colonies declared independence, won the Revolutionary War with French help and governed loosely under the Articles of Confederation.
usa.summary_zh: 北美殖民地宣布独立，在法国援助下赢得独立战争，并依据《邦联条例》实行松散治理。

usa.name: Early Republic
usa.summary: The Constitution created a federal government; Washington, Jefferson and their successors built institutions, bought Louisiana and fought the War of 1812.
usa.summary_zh: 宪法确立联邦政府；华盛顿、杰斐逊等人奠定国家制度，购买路易斯安那，并进行1812年战争。

usa.name: Jacksonian Era and Westward Expansion
usa.name_zh: 杰克逊时代与西进运动
usa.summary: Mass democracy, Manifest Destiny and the Mexican War pushed the nation to the Pacific, while the slavery question grew ever more divisive.
usa.summary_zh: 大众民主兴起，在“昭昭天命”与美墨战争中国土扩展至太平洋，奴隶制问题则日益分裂国家。

usa.name: Civil War and Reconstruction
usa.summary: The Union defeated the Confederacy and abolished slavery; Reconstruction tried to rebuild the South and secure Black rights before it was abandoned.
usa.summary_zh: 联邦击败南部邦联并废除奴隶制；重建时期试图重建南方、保障黑人权利，最终半途而废。

usa.name: Gilded Age
usa.summary: Railroads, steel and oil trusts made the US the world's largest industrial economy amid mass immigration, labor conflict and political corruption.
usa.summary_zh: 铁路、钢铁和石油托拉斯使美国成为世界头号工业经济体，同时伴随大规模移民、劳资冲突和政治腐败。

usa.name: Progressive Era
usa.summary: Reformers regulated big business, cleaned up government and won women's suffrage momentum, and the US entered the First World War.
usa.summary_zh: 改革者规制大企业、整顿政府，推动妇女选举权运动，美国并参加第一次世界大战。

usa.name: Roaring Twenties
usa.summary: A consumer boom of cars, radio and jazz coincided with Prohibition, nativism and isolation from European affairs.
usa.summary_zh: 汽车、收音机和爵士乐带动消费繁荣，同时伴随禁酒令、排外主义和对欧洲事务的孤立态度。

usa.name: Great Depression and New Deal
usa.summary: The 1929 crash brought mass unemployment; Franklin Roosevelt's New Deal expanded federal power with relief, regulation and social security.
usa.summary_zh: 1929年股市崩盘造成大规模失业；富兰克林·罗斯福的新政通过救济、监管和社会保障扩大了联邦权力。

usa.name: Second World War
usa.summary: After Pearl Harbor the US mobilized its economy and armies to defeat Germany and Japan, emerging as a superpower with the atomic bomb.
usa.summary_zh: 珍珠港事件后，美国全面动员经济与军队击败德日，凭借原子弹成为超级大国。

usa.name: Cold War Era
usa.summary: The US led the Western bloc against the Soviet Union, fought in Korea and Vietnam, and was transformed at home by the civil rights movement.
usa.summary_zh: 美国领导西方阵营与苏联对抗，参加朝鲜战争和越南战争，国内则经历民权运动的深刻变革。

usa.name: Post-Cold War Decade
usa.summary: As the sole superpower the US enjoyed a long tech-driven boom and promoted globalization.
usa.summary_zh: 美国作为唯一超级大国，享受由科技推动的长期繁荣，并推动全球化。

usa.name: Post-9/11 Era
usa.summary: The September 11 attacks led to wars in Afghanistan and Iraq; the 2008 crisis, digital transformation and sharp polarization shaped politics.
usa.summary_zh: 九一一袭击引发阿富汗和伊拉克战争；2008年金融危机、数字化变革和严重的政治极化塑造了这一时代。

mexico.name: First Mexican Empire
mexico.summary: Independence was achieved under Agustín de Iturbide, who crowned himself emperor before being overthrown.
mexico.summary_zh: 墨西哥在伊图尔维德领导下实现独立，他自立为皇帝，不久被推翻。

mexico.name: Early Republic and Santa Anna
mexico.name_zh: 早期共和国与圣安纳时代
mexico.summary: Coups and the caudillo Santa Anna dominated a fragile republic that lost Texas and then half its territory in the war with the United States.
mexico.summary_zh: 政变频仍，军事强人圣安纳主导脆弱的共和国；墨西哥先失去得克萨斯，又在美墨战争中丧失一半领土。

mexico.name: Reform and French Intervention
mexico.summary: Juárez and the liberals curbed Church and army privileges, won the Reform War and defeated Maximilian's French-backed empire.
mexico.summary_zh: 华雷斯与自由派削减教会和军队特权，赢得改革战争，并击败法国扶植的马克西米利安帝国。

mexico.name: Porfiriato
mexico.summary: Porfirio Díaz ruled as dictator, attracting foreign capital for railways and mines while land concentrated in few hands.
mexico.summary_zh: 波菲里奥·迪亚斯实行独裁，引进外资修建铁路、开发矿业，土地却高度集中于少数人手中。

mexico.name: Mexican Revolution
mexico.summary: Madero, Zapata, Villa and Carranza overthrew Díaz and fought each other; the 1917 Constitution promised land reform and labor rights.
mexico.summary_zh: 马德罗、萨帕塔、比利亚和卡兰萨推翻迪亚斯后相互混战；1917年宪法承诺土地改革和劳工权利。

mexico.name: Post-Revolutionary State
mexico.summary: Sonoran generals rebuilt the state and founded the ruling party; Cárdenas redistributed land and nationalized oil in 1938.
mexico.summary_zh: 索诺拉派将领重建国家并创立执政党；卡德纳斯大规模分配土地，并于1938年将石油收归国有。

mexico.name: Mexican Miracle
mexico.summary: Under PRI one-party rule Mexico industrialized and urbanized rapidly, though the 1968 Tlatelolco massacre exposed its authoritarianism.
mexico.summary_zh: 在革命制度党一党统治下，墨西哥迅速工业化和城市化，但1968年特拉特洛尔科屠杀暴露了其威权本质。

mexico.name: Crises and Neoliberal Turn
mexico.name_zh: 危机与新自由主义转向
mexico.summary: Oil booms ended in debt crises; Mexico liberalized its economy, joined NAFTA, and the PRI's hold slowly weakened.
mexico.summary_zh: 石油繁荣以债务危机告终；墨西哥推行经济自由化、加入北美自由贸易协定，革命制度党的统治逐渐松动。

mexico.name: Democratic Transition
mexico.summary: Vicente Fox ended 71 years of PRI rule; competitive politics coexisted with a brutal drug war and, from 2018, the Morena party's dominance.
mexico.summary_zh: 福克斯结束革命制度党71年的执政；多党竞争的同时，残酷的毒品战争持续，2018年起国家复兴运动党占据主导。

brazil.name: First Reign
brazil.summary: Pedro I declared independence from Portugal and founded the Empire of Brazil, but his autocratic rule led to his abdication.
brazil.summary_zh: 佩德罗一世宣布脱离葡萄牙独立，建立巴西帝国，但其专断统治导致他被迫退位。

brazil.name: Regency Period
brazil.summary: Regents governed for the child Pedro II amid provincial revolts that threatened national unity.
brazil.summary_zh: 摄政者代年幼的佩德罗二世执政，各省叛乱频发，威胁国家统一。

brazil.name: Second Reign
brazil.summary: Pedro II's long reign brought stability, coffee prosperity and the Paraguayan War, ending soon after slavery was abolished in 1888.
brazil.summary_zh: 佩德罗二世长期统治带来稳定与咖啡繁荣，并经历巴拉圭战争；1888年废除奴隶制后不久帝制即告终结。

brazil.name: First Republic
brazil.summary: A federal republic dominated by coffee oligarchies of São Paulo and Minas Gerais, the 'coffee with milk' politics.
brazil.summary_zh: 联邦共和国由圣保罗和米纳斯吉拉斯的咖啡寡头把持，即所谓“咖啡加牛奶”政治。

brazil.name: Vargas Era
brazil.summary: Getúlio Vargas seized power in 1930 and built the centralized, corporatist Estado Novo, promoting industry and labor laws.
brazil.summary_zh: 热图利奥·瓦加斯于1930年夺权，建立中央集权的“新国家”体制，推动工业化和劳工立法。

brazil.name: Fourth Republic
brazil.summary: A democratic interlude saw developmentalism and the building of Brasília, amid growing polarization.
brazil.summary_zh: 民主间歇期推行发展主义并兴建巴西利亚，但政治日益两极分化。

brazil.name: Military Dictatorship
brazil.summary: Generals ruled after the 1964 coup, presiding over the 'economic miracle', censorship and repression before a gradual opening.
brazil.summary_zh: 1964年政变后将军们执政，经历“经济奇迹”，同时实行审查和镇压，后逐步开放。

brazil.name: New Republic
brazil.summary: Democracy returned with the 1988 Constitution; the Real Plan tamed inflation and the Lula, Rousseff and Bolsonaro years were marked by booms, scandals and polarization.
brazil.summary_zh: 1988年宪法恢复民主；雷亚尔计划遏制通胀，卢拉、罗塞夫和博索纳罗时期经历繁荣、丑闻与政治极化。

argentina.name: Independence Wars
argentina.summary: The May Revolution ended Spanish rule in Buenos Aires; independence was declared in 1816 and San Martín carried the war to Chile and Peru.
argentina.summary_zh: 五月革命结束了西班牙对布宜诺斯艾利斯的统治；1816年宣布独立，圣马丁将战争推进到智利和秘鲁。

argentina.name: Anarchy and Civil Wars
argentina.summary: Central authority collapsed as Unitarians and Federalists fought over the shape of the nation.
argentina.summary_zh: 中央政权瓦解，统一派与联邦派为国家体制而相互争战。

argentina.name: Rosas Era
argentina.summary: Juan Manuel de Rosas ruled Buenos Aires as a Federalist strongman until defeated at Caseros.
argentina.summary_zh: 胡安·曼努埃尔·德罗萨斯以联邦派强人身份统治布宜诺斯艾利斯，直至在卡塞罗斯战败。

argentina.name: National Organization
argentina.summary: The 1853 Constitution and the reunification with Buenos Aires built a national state under Mitre and Sarmiento, while the Paraguayan War was fought.
argentina.summary_zh: 1853年宪法颁布，布宜诺斯艾利斯重新并入，在米特雷和萨缅托治下建立起全国政权，并进行了巴拉圭战争。

argentina.name: Conservative Republic
argentina.summary: An oligarchic elite oversaw an export boom of beef and grain and huge European immigration, making Argentina one of the richest countries.
argentina.summary_zh: 寡头精英主导牛肉和谷物出口繁荣，引进大量欧洲移民，使阿根廷跻身世界最富裕国家之列。

argentina.name: Radical Governments
argentina.summary: After universal male suffrage, Yrigoyen's Radical Civic Union governed and broadened political participation.
argentina.summary_zh: 实行男子普选后，伊里戈延领导的激进公民联盟执政，扩大了政治参与。

argentina.name: Infamous Decade
argentina.summary: A military coup opened a period of fraudulent conservative rule amid the Depression.
argentina.summary_zh: 军事政变开启了大萧条背景下以选举舞弊维持的保守派统治。

argentina.name: Perón Era
argentina.summary: Juan Perón and Evita built a mass movement of workers, nationalizing industries and expanding social rights until a 1955 coup.
argentina.summary_zh: 胡安·庇隆与艾薇塔建立起工人群众运动，推行国有化、扩大社会权利，直至1955年被政变推翻。

argentina.name: Era of Instability
argentina.summary: Peronism was banned as weak civilian governments alternated with military regimes; Perón's brief return in 1973 ended in chaos.
argentina.summary_zh: 庇隆主义遭禁，软弱的文官政府与军政权交替执政；庇隆1973年短暂回归，最终陷入混乱。

argentina.name: Military Dictatorship
argentina.summary: The junta's 'Dirty War' disappeared thousands; defeat in the 1982 Falklands War brought its collapse.
argentina.summary_zh: 军政府发动“肮脏战争”，致使数以万计的人失踪；1982年马岛战争失败后军政府垮台。

argentina.name: Democratic Era
argentina.summary: Democracy has endured through hyperinflation, the 2001 default, Kirchnerism and Milei's libertarian shock therapy.
argentina.summary_zh: 民主制度历经恶性通胀、2001年债务违约、基什内尔主义以及米莱的自由主义“休克疗法”而延续至今。

canada-1824.name: Confederation and Expansion
canada-1824.summary: Macdonald's Dominion of Canada absorbed the Northwest and British Columbia, built the transcontinental railway and crushed the Métis resistance.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 麦克唐纳领导的加拿大自治领并入西北地区和不列颠哥伦比亚，修建横贯大陆铁路，并镇压梅蒂人起义。

canada-1824.name: Laurier Boom
canada-1824.summary: Under Laurier, wheat and immigration settled the Prairies, and Alberta and Saskatchewan became provinces.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 劳里埃执政期间，小麦种植和移民潮开发了草原地区，阿尔伯塔和萨斯喀彻温建省。

canada-1824.name: First World War
canada-1824.summary: Canada's troops won fame at Vimy Ridge, while the conscription crisis deeply divided English and French Canadians.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 加拿大军队在维米岭一役中声名鹊起，征兵危机则严重分裂了英裔和法裔加拿大人。

canada-1824.name: Interwar Years
canada-1824.summary: Canada gained full legislative independence by the Statute of Westminster (1931) and suffered severely in the Depression.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 1931年《威斯敏斯特法》使加拿大获得完全立法独立，随后在大萧条中遭受重创。

canada-1824.name: Second World War
canada-1824.summary: Canada mobilized over a million people, landed at Juno Beach and emerged as an industrial middle power.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 加拿大动员了一百多万人，参加朱诺海滩登陆，战后成为工业化的中等强国。

canada-1824.name: Postwar Prosperity
canada-1824.summary: Newfoundland joined Confederation, Canada helped found NATO and enjoyed a boom in resources and suburbs.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 纽芬兰加入联邦，加拿大参与创建北约，资源开发和郊区化带来繁荣。

canada-1824.name: Quiet Revolution and Trudeau Era
canada-1824.name_zh: 寂静革命与特鲁多时代
canada-1824.summary: Quebec modernized and nationalism surged; Pierre Trudeau introduced official bilingualism, multiculturalism and universal medicare took hold.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 魁北克实现现代化，民族主义高涨；皮埃尔·特鲁多推行官方双语和多元文化政策，全民医保普及。

canada-1824.name: Patriation and Constitutional Battles
canada-1824.summary: The constitution was patriated with a Charter of Rights; failed accords and the 1995 Quebec referendum nearly split the country.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 宪法连同《权利与自由宪章》收归加拿大；宪政协议相继失败，1995年魁北克公投险些导致国家分裂。

canada-1824.name: Contemporary Canada
canada-1824.summary: Budget surpluses, diverse immigration, reconciliation with Indigenous peoples and trade tensions with the US define modern Canada.
canada-1824.summary_zh: 财政盈余、多元移民、与原住民的和解以及与美国的贸易摩擦构成了当代加拿大的主要特征。

inca.name: Kingdom of Cusco
inca.summary: Founded according to legend by Manco Cápac, the Inca were one small chiefdom among many in the Cusco valley.
inca.summary_zh: 据传由曼科·卡帕克建立，印加人当时只是库斯科谷地众多小酋邦之一。

inca.name: Pachacuti's Expansion
inca.summary: After defeating the Chanka, Pachacuti rebuilt Cusco, reorganized the state and conquered the central Andes, founding Tawantinsuyu.
inca.summary_zh: 帕查库提击败昌卡人后重建库斯科、改组国家并征服安第斯中部，建立“塔万廷苏尤”。

inca.name: Reign of Túpac Inca
inca.summary: Túpac Inca Yupanqui extended the empire north to Quito and south into Chile, conquering the Chimú.
inca.summary_zh: 图帕克·印卡·尤潘基将帝国向北扩至基多、向南延伸至智利，并征服奇穆王国。

inca.name: Reign of Huayna Cápac
inca.summary: The empire reached its height and roads stretched 4,000 km, but Huayna Cápac died of a European-borne epidemic.
inca.summary_zh: 帝国达到鼎盛，道路绵延四千公里，但瓦伊纳·卡帕克死于欧洲人带来的瘟疫。

inca.name: Civil War and Spanish Conquest
inca.summary: Atahualpa defeated Huáscar in civil war, only to be captured and executed by Pizarro, who seized Cusco.
inca.summary_zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕在内战中击败瓦斯卡尔，随即被皮萨罗俘虏处死，西班牙人占领库斯科。

inca.name: Neo-Inca State of Vilcabamba
inca.summary: Manco Inca's rebellion failed and the Incas held out in the jungle at Vilcabamba until Túpac Amaru was executed in 1572.
inca.summary_zh: 曼科·印卡起义失败后，印加人退守丛林中的比尔卡班巴，直至1572年图帕克·阿马鲁被处决。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Babur and Humayun
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Babur won at Panipat and founded the empire; his son Humayun lost it to Sher Shah Suri.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 巴布尔在帕尼帕特获胜建立帝国，其子胡马雍却被舍尔沙·苏尔夺去江山。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Sur Interregnum
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Sher Shah Suri ruled north India and reformed revenue and roads, until Humayun returned from Persia.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 舍尔沙·苏尔统治北印度并改革税制、修建道路，直至胡马雍从波斯返回。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Reign of Akbar
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Akbar expanded the empire across north India, built an efficient mansabdari administration and pursued religious tolerance.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 阿克巴将帝国扩展至整个北印度，建立高效的曼萨卜达尔制度，并推行宗教宽容。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Jahangir and Shah Jahan
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Mughal art and architecture flourished, crowned by the Taj Mahal and Shahjahanabad (Delhi).
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 莫卧儿艺术与建筑达于极盛，以泰姬陵和沙贾汉纳巴德（德里）为代表。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Reign of Aurangzeb
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Aurangzeb pushed the empire to its greatest extent in the Deccan, but costly wars and harsh religious policies provoked Maratha, Sikh and Rajput resistance.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 奥朗则布将帝国扩展至德干高原达到最大版图，但战争耗费巨大、宗教政策严苛，激起马拉塔人、锡克人和拉其普特人的反抗。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Mughal Decline
mughal-empire-1644.summary: Provinces broke away, Nader Shah sacked Delhi in 1739, and the British won at Plassey and Buxar.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 各省纷纷自立，1739年纳迪尔沙洗劫德里，英国人在普拉西和布克萨尔战役中获胜。

mughal-empire-1644.name: Twilight under British Ascendancy
mughal-empire-1644.name_zh: 英国势力下的残余帝国
mughal-empire-1644.summary: The emperor became a pensioner of the East India Company, ruling little beyond Delhi; the 1857 rebellion ended the dynasty.
mughal-empire-1644.summary_zh: 皇帝沦为东印度公司的领俸者，统治范围仅限德里一带；1857年大起义后王朝覆灭。

india-1945.name: Partition and the Nehru Era
india-1945.name_zh: 印巴分治与尼赫鲁时代
india-1945.summary: Independence came with the trauma of Partition; Nehru built a secular democratic republic, planned economy and non-alignment.
india-1945.summary_zh: 独立伴随着印巴分治的创痛；尼赫鲁建立世俗民主共和国，推行计划经济和不结盟政策。

india-1945.name: Indira Gandhi and the Emergency
india-1945.name_zh: 英迪拉·甘地与紧急状态
india-1945.summary: Wars with Pakistan, the Green Revolution and Indira Gandhi's centralizing rule culminated in the 1975-77 Emergency.
india-1945.summary_zh: 与巴基斯坦的战争、绿色革命以及英迪拉·甘地的集权统治，最终导致1975—1977年的紧急状态。

india-1945.name: Janata and Late Congress Years
india-1945.summary: The first non-Congress government gave way to Indira's return, her assassination and Rajiv Gandhi's rule amid regional insurgencies.
india-1945.summary_zh: 首个非国大党政府下台后英迪拉复出，后遇刺身亡，拉吉夫·甘地执政期间地方叛乱不断。

india-1945.name: Economic Liberalization
india-1945.summary: The 1991 crisis triggered market reforms; coalition governments, the BJP's rise and nuclear tests reshaped politics.
india-1945.summary_zh: 1991年危机促成市场化改革；联合政府、印度人民党崛起和核试验重塑了政治格局。

india-1945.name: UPA Government
india-1945.summary: Manmohan Singh's Congress-led coalition oversaw rapid growth and welfare programs, later marred by corruption scandals.
india-1945.summary_zh: 曼莫汉·辛格领导的国大党联合政府带来经济高速增长和福利项目，后期为腐败丑闻所累。

india-1945.name: Modi Era
india-1945.summary: Narendra Modi's BJP governments pursued Hindu nationalism, digital infrastructure and great-power ambitions.
india-1945.summary_zh: 纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度人民党政府推行印度教民族主义，发展数字基础设施，追求大国地位。
